verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's Coach and MCP-server capabilities generate AI-driven insights directly from customer data: ticket quality scoring across 100% of conversations, knowledge-base gap/quality audits, root-cause diagnosis of tickets, and analytics on resolution quality, satisfaction, and revenue impact, with Coach able to 'implement improvements... or make suggestions for you to action yourself.' This is all first-party documentation without independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/third-party validation of insight quality and real-world usage examples beyond vendor docs.
